description: This is a white, classic-style table lamp. The lampshade is a flared cone shape, featuring a series of vertical pleats that create a textured, elegant look. Below the shade, the lamp stem is adorned with stacked, spherical elements, with the central sphere featuring a subtle spiral or ribbed texture. The base of the lamp is ornate, with intricate detailing and scrolled feet, suggesting a traditional or vintage design. The overall aesthetic is one of refined elegance and classic design, suitable for adding a touch of sophistication to a room. The clean white finish gives it a versatile and timeless appeal.
